card.name: Linking words in drug interaction findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "that", "by" and "to", or "affected", right after a drug-interaction result verb or concentration noun. Seen in pharmacokinetic interaction sections where one drug's effect on another's levels is reported.

modes.label: That after study verbs
modes.description: The word "that" after verbs like showed, indicate or suggest, introducing an interaction finding.
modes.example: A study in healthy volunteers showed<< that>> tetrabenazine tablets (25

modes.label: By or to after exposure change
modes.description: "by" or "to" after a drug's concentration or exposure change, leading to the other drug that caused it.
modes.example: Increases of 5-fluorouracil plasma concentrations<< by>> approximately 20% have been observed

modes.label: Affected after not
modes.description: The word "affected" in statements that one drug's levels were not changed by another.
modes.example: the pharmacokinetics of duloxetine were not<< affected>> by co-administration. 7.

card.plain: It fires on the little connecting words in sentences that report how one drug changes another drug's blood levels.
